title: Ergodic Mean Field Games of Controls with State Constraints
summary: In a mean field game of controls, players seek to minimize a cost that depends on the joint distribution of players' states and controls. We consider an ergodic problem for second-order mean field games of controls with state constraints, in which equilibria are characterized by solutions to a second-order MFGC system where the value function blows up at the boundary, the density of players vanishes at a commensurate rate, and the joint distribution of states and controls satisfies the appropriate fixed-point relation.
